critic.fix_suggestion: Apply a rotation transform to the wing primitives along their local Y-axis (lateral) to achieve a 35-degree rearward sweep relative to the fuselage longitudinal axis. Simultaneously, taper the outer width of the wing tip primitive by 40% and rotate it 5 degrees upward to create a swept-back, canted wingtip geometry.

discrepancies.observed: Two engines visible under the wing
Wings are nearly perpendicular to the fuselage
discrepancies.reference: Significant rearward sweep of the wings
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: rotate wing primitives backward along the longitudinal axis

discrepancies.observed: Engines appear centered under the wing
discrepancies.reference: Engines mounted forward on the wing leading edge
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: move engine primitives forward toward the wing root

discrepancies.reference: Tapered wingtips with slight upward cant
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: taper width of wing tip primitive and rotate slightly upward
